description:
Melt Away Stress | Sarangi | 1.5 Hours to Release the Pressure

You can put the day down now. Whatever you carried home - in the neck, the jaw, the shoulders - this is ninety minutes to let it go.

This slow Indian sarangi music is designed to melt away stress: a warm, voice-like sound that the body softens to, phrase by phrase.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of low, gentle sarangi over a steady tanpura drone, with no drums and no vocals.

▶ Keep unwinding — the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for decompressing after work, evening stress relief, burnout recovery, stretching, a warm bath, lying down with your eyes closed, breathwork, a quiet dinner, or the hour before bed.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sarangi (Indian bowed strings) with tanpura drone
Raga: Desh (a warm, gentle evening raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Warm, heavy, releasing
Atmosphere: Home at dusk, the bag set down, nothing left to do
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on when you get home and sit or lie back. Let each long bowed note loosen one place at a time and breathe out longer than you breathe in.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Arriving home
9:00 Setting it down
18:00 Shoulders dropping
27:00 A slower breath
36:00 Warmth in the chest
45:00 The pressure eases
54:00 Heavy and easy
1:03:00 Stress melting away
1:12:00 Quiet all the way through
1:21:00 Rest now

⏱ BEST FOR
• Stress relief
• Body tension
• Burnout recovery
• Decompressing after work
• Stretching
• A warm bath
• Breathwork
• Before bed

If this music helped you, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
